title: Integrated MultImodaL anaLysis for prEdictioN of response after local ablatioN in metastatIc breast cAncer
summary: This is a retrospective data analysis at one location without blinding. The biomaterials (blood and tissue) used were obtained as part of routine examinations in the past. These biomaterials come from routine examinations or from study samples from patients who have taken part in the ESTIMATE study in the past.

interventions.name: To evaluate the immunological, proteomic, , transcriptomic, metabolomic and microbiome profiles in tumor tissues and blood (plasma, serum, leukocytes) as prognostic markers for progression free survival and overall survival after local ablation. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1.	Availability of tissue and blood samples collected in frame of the ESTIMATE study 
2.	Diagnosis of metastatic breast cancer
Exclusion criteria:
1.	Absence of tissues and blood samples collected in frame of the ESTIMATE study
